property_summary: For all callers and amounts, the reference contract allows the owner to successfully call sendTo (call does not revert and may transfer), whereas the mutant rejects calls from the owner (require(msg.sender != owner)), so there exists inputs (caller == owner) that make the mutant revert while the reference accepts them.
change_summary: Replace the require guard checking msg.sender == owner with require(msg.sender != owner), allowing only non-owners to call and thus changing transfer behavior observable via sendTo.
